title: Account Settings
subtitle: Manage contact information and identity verification

email.description: Email is used for sign-in, security notifications, and account recovery.
email.fieldDescription: A verification code is sent to the new email and replaces the current value after confirmation.

mobile.description: Mobile is used for sign-in and confirming sensitive changes.
mobile.fieldDescription: Enter the number with country code; the verification code is sent to this number.

tracePrivacy.title: Tracing Privacy
tracePrivacy.description: Configure tenant-level prompt/response trace capture policy. This overrides the global default when set.

messages.updateFailed: Failed to update trace privacy policy.

none.title: None
none.description: Do not capture prompt/response payloads in traces.

metadataOnly.title: Metadata-only
metadataOnly.description: Capture only payload metadata like size and checksums.

sampledRedacted.title: Sampled-redacted
sampledRedacted.description: Capture redacted payload snapshots with hashed sensitive values.

fullSecure.title: Full-secure
fullSecure.description: Store encrypted payload blobs at rest and keep references in trace spans.

requestLogging.title: Request Logging
requestLogging.description: Control how much request and response content is stored in request logs for this tenant.

messages.updateFailed: Failed to update request logging mode.

none.title: None
none.description: Do not store request or response content, and keep only minimal operational counters.

metadataOnly.title: Metadata-only
metadataOnly.description: Store request metadata, routing outcomes, latency, token usage, and cost without raw payloads.

redactedContent.title: Redacted content
redactedContent.description: Store payload snapshots after redaction and size capping for safer debugging.

fullContent.title: Full content
fullContent.description: Store request and response payloads inline up to the configured cap for maximum troubleshooting visibility.
